description: This PHP source file defines the PostObjectV4 class, which encapsulates the logic for generating a POST upload form for Amazon S3 using AWS Signature Version 4. It manages form attributes, inputs, and signature generation, and interacts with AWS SDK components for credentials and signing.

classes.name: PostObjectV4
classes.description: A class responsible for generating signed POST forms for uploading objects to S3 with Signature V4, including managing form attributes, inputs, policies, and signatures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new PostObjectV4 instance, initializing form attributes, preparing policy and signature based on credentials and options.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the S3 client used for the upload.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the bucket name targeted for the upload.

methods.name: getFormAttributes
methods.description: Returns the form attributes as an array, including action URL and method.

methods.name: setFormAttribute
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific form attribute.

methods.name: getFormInputs
methods.description: Returns the form inputs array, including signature and credential info.

methods.name: setFormInput
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific form input.

methods.name: generateUri
methods.description: Generates the URI for the S3 POST endpoint, considering path-style or virtual-hosted style.

methods.name: getPolicyAndSignature
methods.description: Generates the policy document and signature needed for the signed form submission, based on credentials and policy conditions.
